roadmapLane: P1-A: same supplied unsigned block, intent/hash/nonce/original-price checks and declared public-byte/payer-address mapping

implementation.mapping: Require a present canonical Base64 32-byte publicKey through the existing unsigned-field grammar; compare 0x00 || first19(SHA3-256(publicKeyBytes)) with the existing decoded actual payer address core.
implementation.reuse: Reuse the complete existing unsigned hash/nonce path, or the original intent/hash/nonce/price binding, then check the same returned detached block's supplied public-key bytes. No mutable caller field is reread after await.
implementation.why: publicKey is not included in the account-block hash preimage. A hash-correct and nonce-consistent record can still supply an empty or unrelated key; the new stage refuses that mismatch without changing the earlier APIs.
implementation.resourceBound: One additional SHA3-256 over exactly 32 supplied bytes plus a 20-byte comparison. No key generation, curve operation, signature check, nonce search, SDK or native work provider.
implementation.unchanged: Every existing source/API/default/active buyer, SDK comparator, package, workflow and local HTTPS owner candidate remains byte-identical.
implementation.labels: Only MATCHES_SUPPLIED_PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES. Key possession and chain authentication are NOT_ESTABLISHED; signature validation is NOT_PERFORMED; authority and after-signing action remain NONE.
implementation.nestedReceipts: Earlier hash/work receipt labels retain their original narrower scope and are not rewritten to claim the additional key check. New scope/version is separate.

qualification.vectors: Fixed public-byte literals only, including zero bytes to explicitly distinguish byte mapping from valid-curve/key-possession claims. An independent synthetic Bech32 encoder checks the production decoder. Both mappings rely on Node's SHA3 primitive.
